bute_oldman.text: Alright, butt. That is what we say in Cardiff. Butt means mate.
This is Butetown, known as Tiger Bay. Sailors from all over the world lived here, and it is one of the oldest mixed communities in Britain.
Shirley Bassey was born round the corner. When she sang, the whole bay listened. So did the Chipgulls, but only for chips.

then.text: Back for the Glamorgan Sausage? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: No pork. Cheese and leeks. Don't look like that, you'll love it.
Caerphilly, leeks and breadcrumbs, bound with egg. Roll them in more crumbs and fry. Mustard in the mix gives it a kick.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
